Legal Requirement: No person shall prepack or cause or permit to be pre-packed any commodity for sale... unless the package... bears thereon... such declarations as are required.
Simplified Requirement: All packages must have mandatory declarations printed or affixed before distribution.
Applicable Product/Condition: All pre-packaged commodities intended for retail sale.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Presence of mandatory declarations on package/label.
Validation Condition: All required fields (Rule 6) are physically present on the package.
Non-Compliance Condition: Packages leave the manufacturer/packer without required declarations.
Notes/Exceptions: Does not apply to wholesale, industrial/institutional consumers, or packages >25kg/25L (Rule 3).

Legal Requirement: Every package shall bear... the name and address of the manufacturer, or... packer and... importer.
Simplified Requirement: Label must show the complete name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: 'Manufactured by', 'Packed by', or 'Imported by' with a complete address.
Validation Condition: Name and complete address (enabling location identification) are present.
Non-Compliance Condition: Missing or incomplete manufacturer, packer, or importer details.
Notes/Exceptions: For food articles, Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954 applies instead.

Legal Requirement: The common or generic names of the commodity... and in case of packages with more than one product, the name and number or quantity of each.
Simplified Requirement: Must state the generic name of the product, and itemize quantities for multi-product packages.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Generic product name; itemized list for multi-product packages.

Legal Requirement: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure... or the number of the commodity.
Simplified Requirement: Must state how much product is inside by standard weight, volume, area, length, or count.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Net quantity value and standard International System of Units (SI) symbol.
Validation Condition: Numeric value followed by correct standard unit.
Non-Compliance Condition: Missing net quantity or using non-standard/imperial units.
Notes/Exceptions: Excludes the weight of wrappers and packaging materials (Rule 11(1)).

Legal Requirement: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned.
Simplified Requirement: Must state the specific month and year of manufacturing, packing, or import.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Month and Year declaration (in words, numerals, or both).
Validation Condition: Month and Year are present and legible.
Non-Compliance Condition: Missing month and year of manufacture/packing/import.
Notes/Exceptions: Exempt for bidis, incense sticks, and specific APM LPG cylinders. Food and cosmetics follow their respective specific Acts.

Legal Requirement: The retail sale price of the package... printed... 'Maximum or Max. retail price Rs.../₹... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP Rs.../₹... incl., of all taxes'.
Simplified Requirement: Must state the MRP using the exact required phrases, including 'inclusive of all taxes'.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: 'MRP Rs... incl., of all taxes' or permitted variant.
Validation Condition: Text matches the explicitly permitted MRP format.
Non-Compliance Condition: MRP is missing or fails to state 'inclusive of all taxes'.
Notes/Exceptions: Exempt for bidis and APM LPG cylinders.

Legal Requirement: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, E-mail address, if available, of the person... to be contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
Simplified Requirement: Must provide consumer care contact details (Name, Address, Phone, Email if available).
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Consumer care address and telephone number.
Validation Condition: Telephone number and contact address are present.
Non-Compliance Condition: Missing phone number or address for consumer complaints.

Legal Requirement: It shall not be permissible to affix individual stickers on the package for altering or making declaration required under these rules.
Simplified Requirement: Cannot use stickers to override or provide mandatory declarations, except for price reductions.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Absence of stickers over mandatory information.
Validation Condition: Mandatory info is directly printed/labeled, not stickered over (unless reducing MRP).
Non-Compliance Condition: Sticker covers original MRP to increase price, or alters other mandatory declarations.
Evidence Required: Photograph showing physical sticker over original text.
Notes/Exceptions: Exception: A sticker with a revised lower MRP is allowed but must not cover the original MRP.

Legal Requirement: The height of any numeral in the declaration... shall not be less than... shown in Table-I/II. Height of letters... not less than 1 mm...
Simplified Requirement: Text and numbers must meet minimum size requirements based on the package's weight/volume or area.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Font height and width in mm.
Validation Condition: Character heights match Table I/II thresholds (e.g., >= 1mm).
Non-Compliance Condition: Text is smaller than the mandated minimum height (1mm) or width (1/3 of height).
Notes/Exceptions: Exception for numeral '1' and letters (i), (l), and (I) regarding the width rule.

Legal Requirement: The area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information: above and below by a space equal to at least the height of the numeral...
Simplified Requirement: Quantity declaration must have a required clear blank space around it.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Blank space dimensions around net quantity.
Validation Condition: Vertical clearance = 1x numeral height; Horizontal clearance = 2x numeral height.
Non-Compliance Condition: Other text/graphics infringe on the required clear space zone around the quantity.

Legal Requirement: Numerals of the retail sale price and net quantity declaration shall be printed... in a colour that contrasts conspicuously with the background.
Simplified Requirement: MRP and Net Quantity must clearly stand out from the label's background color.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Color contrast of MRP and Net Quantity text against background.
Non-Compliance Condition: MRP/Quantity text blends into background making it hard to read.
Notes/Exceptions: Exemption: Information blown, formed, or moulded on a glass or plastic surface.

Legal Requirement: The particulars of the declarations... shall either be in Hindi in Devnagri script or in English.
Simplified Requirement: Mandatory information must be printed in English or Hindi.
Validation Condition: Text is in English or Hindi (Devnagri).
Non-Compliance Condition: Mandatory declarations are exclusively in a regional/foreign language other than Hindi/English.
Notes/Exceptions: The use of other languages in addition to Hindi or English is permitted.

Legal Requirement: Commodities which are likely to undergo significant variations in weight... may be qualified by the words 'when packed', as specified in the Third Schedule.
Simplified Requirement: Specific items (soaps, lotions, creams) can add 'when packed' to quantity.
Applicable Product/Condition: Items in Third Schedule (Soaps, Lotions, Creams).
Non-Compliance Condition: 'When packed' is used on non-eligible commodities (violating Rule 11(2)).
Notes/Exceptions: Must not be used for items not undergoing significant environmental variation.

Legal Requirement: The declaration of quantity shall not contain any word... which tends to create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression...
Simplified Requirement: Do not use estimating words like 'minimum', 'average', 'about', or 'approximately' next to quantity.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Absence of forbidden modifier words near quantity.
Validation Condition: No prohibited words found near net quantity.

Legal Requirement: No retail dealer or other person... shall make any sale of any commodity in packed form at a price exceeding the retail sale price thereof.
Simplified Requirement: No seller can charge a consumer more than the printed MRP.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Final sale price vs. printed MRP.
Non-Compliance Condition: Seller charges more than the printed MRP.
Evidence Required: Purchase receipt and photograph of package MRP.

Legal Requirement: Every wholesale package shall bear... (a) The name and address of the manufacturer or importer... (b) the identity... (c) the total number of retail package... or the net quantity...
Simplified Requirement: Wholesale boxes must state manufacturer info, product identity, and total count/quantity inside.
Declaration/Parameter to Check: Manufacturer name/address, product identity, total retail packages/quantity.
Validation Condition: All 3 requirements are visibly printed on the wholesale container.
Non-Compliance Condition: Wholesale carton lacks manufacturer info or total inner package count.
Notes/Exceptions: Does not apply if similar declarations are required by another law.

Legal Requirement: Every individual, firm... who or which pre-packs or imports any commodity for sale... shall make an application... for the registration of his or its name and complete address.
Simplified Requirement: Manufacturers, packers, and importers must register their name and address with the Legal Metrology authority.
Validation Condition: Entity holds a valid registration certificate under Rule 27.
Non-Compliance Condition: Entity is packing/importing without Legal Metrology registration.
Notes/Exceptions: Application must be made within 90 days of commencing pre-packing/importing.
